title: Get a Radiant Smile: 20, 40, or 60-Minute Zoom Teeth Whitening Treatment at Up to 73% Off at Spatini Skin Lounge
description:
Ready to dazzle with a brighter smile? Spatini Skin Lounge is rolling out the red carpet for your pearly whites! Experience their top-notch teeth whitening treatment, combining cutting-edge technology with personalized care from the Glam Squad.
Your smile will sparkle brighter than ever before, making every moment a chance to shine with confidence. Why wait? Step into Spatini and let your smile steal the show!
What We Offer
One 20-Minute Express Teeth Whitening Treatment One 40-Minute Teeth Whitening Treatment One 60-Minute Teeth Whitening
Couples Teeth Whitening 60 min /each 

Brand of the whitening treatment: Zoom
Benefits: Teeth whitening helps to restore a smile tainted by discoloration. In-office teeth whitening produces the fastest results and is the safest form of teeth whitening.
How it works: Significant color change in a short time is the major benefit of in-office whitening. This protocol involves the carefully controlled use of a relatively high-concentration peroxide gel, applied to the teeth by a trained technician after the gums have been protected with a paint-on rubber dam.
Generally, the peroxide remains on the teeth for several 15 to 20-minute intervals that add up to an hour at most. We use professional brand solutions 22% or 44%. Those with particularly stubborn staining may be advised to return for one or more additional bleaching sessions or may be asked to continue with a home-use system.

Why You Should Grab The Offer
Spatini Skin Lounge offers a unique blend of luxury and convenience with their Lunchtime Lush Happy Hour, providing exclusive midday treatments perfect for busy schedules. Their Glam Squad delivers personalized care from top professionals, ensuring clients receive tailored attention on special days each month. With a focus on customized skincare solutions and non-invasive sculpting treatments, Spatini Skin Lounge addresses individual needs with expertise. The modern Beauty Bar Lounge creates a luxurious ambiance, enhancing the overall experience. Additionally, specialized services for men ensure that everyone finds exactly what they need. Known for its high standards and advanced technology, Spatini Skin Lounge combines years of experience to offer natural and lasting results. With a stellar 4.9-star rating on Groupon, backed by over 300 reviews, this upscale spa is dedicated to high-quality beauty treatments.
